description: Address semantic review findings: (1) Fix twitter:card to use summary_large_image for all posts including video since we lack a dedicated player embed page, (2) Fix getVideoThumbnailUrl fallback for non-Cloudinary URLs to return empty string instead of broken extension-swap URL, (3) Fix post-publish flow to auto-navigate to Profile after a brief delay instead of requiring user to tap a button.
steps: 1. In share.routes.js, change twitter:card for video posts from 'player' to 'summary_large_image' and remove twitter:player, twitter:player:width, twitter:player:height meta tags
2. In share.routes.js, fix getVideoThumbnailUrl() to return empty string for non-Cloudinary URLs instead of doing extension swap
3. In CreateScreen.tsx, replace Alert-button-based navigation with auto-navigation after a delay using setTimeout
acceptance_criteria: All posts (including video) use twitter:card = summary_large_image
No twitter:player meta tag is emitted for any post type
getVideoThumbnailUrl returns empty string for non-Cloudinary video URLs
After successful publish, user is auto-navigated to Profile tab after ~1500ms delay
resetForm() is called appropriately after navigation
verification: Read share.routes.js and confirm twitter:card is always summary_large_image
Read share.routes.js and confirm getVideoThumbnailUrl fallback returns empty string
Read CreateScreen.tsx and confirm setTimeout-based auto-navigation
Run node --check on share.routes.js to validate syntax
